title: Navratri and Dussehra cake near Wentworthville? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Need a cake for the Navratri or Dussehra family gathering and can't be sure it has no eggs? Wentworthville and Pendle Hill families, this one is checked for you.

Every cake from Harris Park is 100% eggless. Not in the sponge, not in the buttercream, not in any of the 15 flavours. So nobody at the table has to ask.

A 10-inch serves 20-22 and starts at $74.99. Custom cakes need 2 days' notice, which is what fresh to order actually takes. Pickup from Wigram Street, open daily 11am to 10pm.

Send a photo reference on WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati.
